label: Proof of FTC Part 2 (specific derivation)
summary: Takes a regular partition of [a,b]; uses the Mean Value Theorem on each subinterval; forms a telescoping sum equal to F(b)−F(a); takes n→∞ to obtain the definite integral and concludes ∫_a^b f(x)dx=F(b)−F(a).
notes: Specific proof/derivation belongs to Study (walkthrough). Reusable method is procedure:prove-ftc-part2. Mathematical notation is condensed in this pilot.
